$comment: Project-scoped Playwright MCP server. Claude Code discovers this file
automatically when a session starts in this repository, so anyone who
clones the repo gets a browser-driving Claude with zero setup.

--save-session                 records each MCP session for later review.
--isolated                     keeps the browser profile in memory, so an
exploration session never leaves stale cookies
behind to poison the next one.
--output-dir                   keeps MCP artefacts out of the test artefacts.
